usage.callShape: POST https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/ipfs/pin with JSON body {"json": {...}} (or {"url": "..."} to pin remote content, or multipart "file" upload)
usage.outputShape: body.cid (the IPFS CID), body.ipfs_url (ipfs:// URI), body.gateway_url (https Pinata gateway URL), body.size, body.name
quirks: Input field name is NOT 'content'/'data'/'file' as JSON text. You MUST send one of: {"json": {...}} to pin a JSON object, {"url": "https://..."} to pin remote content, or a multipart form 'file' upload. Sending other top-level keys returns 400 'Provide json object, url string, or upload a file via multipart form' AFTER charging $0.01.
Backed by Pinata; gateway_url points at gateway.pinata.cloud.
Charges payment even on a 400 bad-body response (got charged once for the wrong field name before the retry succeeded).
usage.guide: POST to the endpoint with a JSON body {"json": {your object}} to pin an arbitrary JSON object to IPFS, or {"url": "https://..."} to pin remote content, or a multipart "file" upload for binaries. Pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Read the result CID from body.cid; use body.ipfs_url or body.gateway_url to fetch it. Do NOT use a top-level "content"/"data" field — it returns 400 and still charges you.
